notes: Extracted 68 items within the 70-item limit following the requested priority order. Cohort covers primary lung cancers (ICD-10 C33-C34) diagnosed 1.1.2018-30.6.2022 with 6-month treatment follow-up in HILMO; survival in Table 5.1 covers 2020-2022 follow-up. Collaborative areas (yhteistyöalueet) map to HUS (Etelä-Suomi), TYKS (Länsi-Suomi), TAYS (Sisä-Suomi), KYS (Itä-Suomi), OYS (Pohjois-Suomi); Åland (79 cases) and 7 cases with missing municipality are excluded from area tables. In Table 3.3, patients may receive multiple treatments within 6 months, and radiotherapy excludes palliative radiotherapy (WF004). In Figure 3.2 and Table 3.5, simultaneous drug and radiotherapy is counted as radiotherapy, and 'Ei hoitotietoa' means no surgery, radiotherapy, or drug therapy recorded as first event within 6 months (including deaths and palliative-only cases). Omitted due to the 70-item cap: wellbeing services county (hyvinvointialue) age-standardised sex-specific shares in Table 3.7 (pages 25-26, 126 county values), collaborative area sex-specific shares in Table 3.6 (page 23), cumulative 6-month multi-state transitions in Tables 4.2-4.6, treatment-stratified 1-year survival in Tables 5.2-5.3, single-year trends, age/histology/subsite breakdowns, and procedure-code appendices. Charts without printed labels (Figures 2.3, 2.4, 3.3, 3.4, 4.2-4.6, 5.1, 5.2) are accompanied by data tables elsewhere in the report.
